caption: This drawing depicts a statue of a young boy standing barefoot on a rectangular gray pedestal. The boy has dark skin and short, curly brown hair. He is dressed in loose, olive-green pants that are cropped at the ankles and a loose, mustard-yellow shirt with short sleeves that is open at the chest, revealing part of his torso. The boy's left arm is relaxed and slightly bent at the elbow, while his right hand is raised and holding a round object with a handle, resembling a small mirror or magnifying glass. The background is plain and off-white. The drawing is signed "David P. Willoughby" in the lower right corner.
title: Hitching Post
